name: VibeWave v2.4.0
body:
### 🚀 VibeWave v2.4.0 Naya Update!

- ✖️ **Notification Cut / Close Button:** Upar scroll down karke direct gana band karne (cut karne) ka option add kar diya gaya hai!
- 🎙️ **Voice Search & Assistant:** Alexa / Google Assistant style bol kar gana search karein!
- ⚡ **Super Smooth 60-120 FPS:** Buttery smooth lag-free performance.
- 🔄 **Direct 1-Tap Update:** Bina purana app delete kiye naye updates install karein!
